summary: refactor(admin-server): check features and names on record-security-event
description:
Because:

* The admin record-security-event route used a read feature and took any event name.

This commit:

* Requires the Remove2FA, ClearEmailBounces or RemovePasskeys feature and adds @AuditLog().
* Accepts only the three event names the admin panel sends, else returns 400.
* Moves the write to a private writeAdminSecurityEvent for internal callers.

Closes FXA-14034
